command: import copy,json,py_compile; from work import evaluate; py_compile.compile('work.py',doraise=True); r={'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}; p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}; e=[{'source':'old','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'x','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}]; before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); assert evaluate(r,e,p)=={'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}; assert (r,e,p)==before; assert evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1}},[],p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']}; c=[{'source':'z','claim':'x','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'x','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}]; assert evaluate(r,c,p)=={'status':'supported','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]}; d=[{'source':'b','claim':'x','value':0,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'x','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}]; assert evaluate(r,d,p)=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}; f=[{'source':'f','claim':'x','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}]; assert evaluate(r,f,p)=={'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]}; requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(x,evidence,policy) for x in requests]; print('all checks passed')
